title: Money & currency
body:
Japanese yen (¥), cash-first once you're west of Matsue/Izumo. Convenience-store ATMs (7-Eleven, Lawson, Family Mart) reliably take foreign cards in both cities; Oda/Omori has only a handful, so carry enough cash for the whole Iwami Ginzan day before you transfer out of Matsue.

No tipping, anywhere. IC cards (ICOCA/Suica/PASMO) cover Matsue-area JR, the Ichibata Railway, and Iwami Kotsu buses, but the JR San-in Line stops accepting IC taps at Izumo-shi Station — buy a paper ticket for anything continuing to Odashi.
